We need answer JSON only. Need evaluate each story for Atomic criterion. Need be careful. We must classify each story. Need no prose outside JSON. Need exactly 60 evaluations. We need assess individual story atomic: does it express exactly one feature? Violation when combines two or more independently implementable/testable/prioritizable features. Do not flag conjunctions that enumerate attributes of one feature.

Need go through each. Need maybe many are atomic? Some have "and" combos. Need parse. Might have multiple features in some. Need decide binary, evidence, rationale.

Important: Criterion individual. Don't use unrelated QUS issues. Only atomic. Some stories may have multi-part goals. Need evaluate whether combined features or one feature with attributes.

Let's list stories and assess.

ZO-001: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting. That's one feature search/discover music, methods alternatives content identification/fingerprinting. Not two independently? likely atomic. No Violation.

ZO-002: search and discover music based on my profile. One feature. Atomic.

ZO-003: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself. One feature. Atomic.

ZO-004: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity. Could be one feature: search/discover similar items (music or ringback tones) based on content similarity. The "music or ringback tones" are object alternatives, not separate features? Atomic likely. But maybe search/discover music and ringback tones could be two? They are one recommendation feature by similarity. No violation.

ZO-005: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path. One feature search/discover with methods and goal alternatives. Atomic? It expresses one feature (search/discover music using metadata/tags) with outcome examples related artists/new genre/listening path. Not independently implementable separate features? Could argue find related artists, new genre, listening path as goals. They are benefits. Atomic. No violation.

ZO-006: As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps. Could combine upload tagged videos and ensure tags available for processing. Is that two features? "upload tagged videos" and "have tags available for all further processing steps" perhaps one workflow feature? Need judge Atomic. It has two conjunctions: upload and have tags available. But maybe the latter is attribute of uploaded videos. Is "tags available for all further processing steps" independently implementable from upload? Potentially yes but maybe not two separate user features? Need classify. We need consistent.

ZO-007: view thumbnail sequences of video segments. One feature. Atomic.

ZO-008: get info about similar video items and segments. "similar video items and segments" are two related entities? Information about similar video items and segments one feature. Atomic? Maybe items and segments are attributes. No violation.

ZO-009: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments. One feature with method perceptual. Atomic.

ZO-010: receive content recommendations from similar profiles. One feature.

ZO-011: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area. One feature.

ZO-012: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them. This combines identification of persons and receiving related info. Is that two features? It says identify persons and receive related information about them. Could be one feature: person recognition with related info display. The "and receive related information" might be a separate feature? Need decide. Operational says do not flag conjunctions that merely enumerate attributes of one feature. Is receiving related info an attribute/outcome of identification? I think many stories have "identify X, and receive related information". They combine two actions: identification and retrieval/display information. Are these independently implementable? Identify persons vs receive related info are potentially separately testable/prioritizable: recognition and info retrieval. However, as user story, person wants to identify persons in videos and receive related info. Could be one coherent feature "person identification with info". But "receive related information" may require separate backend info retrieval. Need assess Atomic strict. The Lucassen example: story combines clicking map location with displaying landmarks associated with that location contains two features. This is similar: identify persons + receive related info = two features? It may be violation. Need maybe flag ZO-012 through ZO-015 as violations because they combine identification with receiving info. But is that like clicking map and displaying landmarks? Yes. We need decide.

ZO-013: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them. same.

ZO-014: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related info. same.

ZO-015: identify brands in videos, and receive related info. same.

Is that one feature? It is input method plus recommendation. Could be atomic? Maybe one feature "recommend videos from image"; take/upload are alternative ways to provide image. However a single feature can have a trigger/input. Likely atomic.
